notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hello,    

Yesterday's patch introduced a couple of unintended crashes. We have pushed a hotfix to resolve these issues:

Game crash when answering the phone with [spoiler]Miranda[/spoiler]

Game crash at the end of the [spoiler]Rabbit Hole mission[/spoiler]

Game crash during the opening scene of the [spoiler]Alex Murphy mission[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
To those tackling the Omni-Tower, 

We've put a new patch live for RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business:

Japanese subtitles have been added

Weapon swap fixes (for some outliers that weren't resolved in Hotfix #2)

Performance Improvements

Stability Fixes

Other Minor Fixes

We hope you're enjoying your time in this action-packed standalone!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello,



We've pushed another hotfix live for RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business that addresses the following issues: 

Fix for the black screen blocker during the [spoiler]Bomb Disarm sequence[/spoiler]

Fix for the Movie Night quest

Fix for enemies disappearing during takedowns

Fix for a crash that could occur when performing finishers on a Heavy Mercenary

We hope you're enjoying your climb through the OmniTower!

notes.title: Launch Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello all,   

Today we pushed a hotfix live to address some of the issues identified since launch: 

Fixed a bug that would prevent players from picking up and changing your additional weapons 

[strike]Fixed a blocker with the [spoiler] bomb defusal sequence[/spoiler][/strike]

Fixed a bug on the 'Damsel in Distress' mission

Replaced some placeholder audio left over on some radio broadcasts

Stability fixes (including some Fatal Crash errors, but we may not have got them all). 

Update 23/07: We're still seeing some issues with one of the blockers we thought were resolved and are looking into it further! 

We're still working on further updates for RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business, including further optimisation improvements. 

Thank you for enjoying Unfinished Business!

notes.title: Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/0fd49b3a9c7692016394486b763e4e2ed30d3ef7.png

Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business

Suit up. A new threat has taken over the OmniTower, and RoboCop is the only one who can stop it.

RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is a brand-new, standalone adventure set after the events of the main game and between the RoboCop 2 and 3 films. It brings back the explosive gameplay and atmosphere you loved, while introducing fresh challenges, new allies, and a deadly news enemies.

[previewyoutube=ibbgOXYagzs;full][/previewyoutube]
New faces. New allies. New enemies. One mission: justice.

You’ll reunite with key characters like Officer Anne Lewis, Sergeant Warren Reed, and ED-209. But standing in RoboCop’s way are dangerous new opponents like Cassius Graves or his right arm Douglas Cole.

Together, they’ve taken control of the OmniTower, a massive residential complex designed to rebuild Old Detroit. RoboCop must fight his way to the top to save innocent lives, and uncover the truth behind the siege.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527760/RoboCop_Rogue_City__Unfinished_Business/
What’s new in Unfinished Business?

A gripping new story set between RoboCop 2 and 3.
New characters and locations.
Powerful new weapons and brutal finish moves.
Speciales missions as Alex Murphy (voiced once again by Peter Weller), ED-209, other...

First press reviews

 GamesRadar+
"RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is more RoboCop but not just more. It's all dialled up. More action. More weapons. More over-the-top. I can't wait to see how high the OmniTower really stretches."

 TechRadar
"I walked away eager to see what else RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business has in store when it arrives for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S on July 17, 2025."

 Mirror
"There’s still a lot to learn about how the story will land and how the Alex Murphy missions will play out. For now, however, it’s still hard to imagine any video game nailing the act of being RoboCop as well as this."

 Metro
 "This is RoboCop: Rogue City with its pedal to the floor, confined and concentrated into a lean, tightly focused machine."


Pre-purchase now to receive the exclusive Prime Directives Pack!

RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business releases on July 17th. 
A Mac version is also in development and coming soon.
